=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:182-192,318-326 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The `_execute` test helper passes the runner's `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER` through to the script and never sets it, so the new rotation `START=$(((RUN_NUMBER * MAX_PER_TICK) % CANDIDATE_COUNT))` in scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh lines 622-627 can start at a nonzero index; `test_per_tick_cap_is_honoured` then fails its assertion at line 325 (`assert "outcome=pending issue=10 reason=no_completed_run" in result.stdout`).
  WHY: CI run 41267984128 (`GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER=3`) examined issues 11 and 12 and failed the test; it passes locally only because the variable is unset there. Sonnet, minimax and openai rated it BLOCKER and gemini gave no severity. minimax cited the env filter at line 226, but glm verified it is at line 182. Fix: add `"GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": "0"` to `env.update`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:456-472 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_verify_one` fetches one newest-first page (`per_page=100`, `created=>=${merged_at}` with no upper bound) and logs `outcome=pending reason=runs_truncated` when `total_count` is over 100. It never pages, so once a workflow has more than 100 runs since the merge, the heal stays pending on every tick.
  WHY: On a busy workflow such as `ci.yml`, the heal leaves the 7-day window without ever getting a held or recurred verdict. Severity disagreement: openai rated it MAJOR (conf 4), sonnet and minimax rated it NIT (conf 3), gemini gave no severity (conf 3). The highest was used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:~593 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: After a successful reopen, if both comment POST attempts fail and the re-close PATCH also fails, the script only warns (`warn reason=comment_failed reclosed=false` plus a WARNING Telegram) and exits 0. The heal stays OPEN with no comment.
  WHY: Later ticks list closed issues only (`issues(first:50,states:CLOSED,…)`), so the open heal drops out of verification with no retry path. minimax rated it MAJOR and gemini gave no severity. sonnet and glm discounted it, because it needs three API failures in a row and is fail-open by design with a logged warning and a Telegram alert.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The per-tick cap is honoured." (acceptance criterion from Linked Issue #8583; tested in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py with a fake `gh`)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py `_execute` helper env setup (line 182 and the `env.update` block after it), or the `test_per_tick_cap_is_honoured` setup (lines 318-326)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither the PR diff nor the LAST RUN DIFF pins `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER` in `_execute()` or in `test_per_tick_cap_is_honoured`; only `test_start_rotates_with_run_number` pins it (`"1"`). CI run 41267984128 (`GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER=3`) fails `assert "outcome=pending issue=10 reason=no_completed_run" in result.stdout`. glm computed that the test fails when RUN_NUMBER mod 5 ∈ {1,3,4}. The script does honour the cap (`examined=2`, two runs reads), but no deterministic test covers this criterion. The one-line fix (`"GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": "0"`) is absent. Severity: gemini and minimax rated it BLOCKER, sonnet and glm rated it MAJOR.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py:182, 318-326 (assertion line 325); scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:622-624 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `_execute` passes runner `GITHUB_*` variables through and never sets `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER`, so `test_per_tick_cap_is_honoured` (5 candidates, cap 2) assumes START=0, which is not guaranteed.
  WHY: START = (run_number * 2) % 5 is 0 only when run_number % 5 == 0. CI run 41267984128 failed with issues 11 and 12 examined. Fix: add `"GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": "0"` to `env.update`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:469-472 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `runs_truncated` guard combined with an unbounded `created=>=${merged_at}` filter means that once there are more than 100 post-merge runs, every tick sees the same newest 100 and stays pending.
  WHY: On a busy branch the heal stays pending until it leaves the 7-day window. Fix: bound `created=${merged_at}..<merged_at + 1 day>`, or page, which breaks the 3-reads budget.
- (Excluded the pass-1 claim that a heal is stuck open after the comment and re-close fail: it needs three consecutive API failures, and that path logs `reclosed=false` and sends a WARNING Telegram.)
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Acceptance criterion "The per-tick cap is honoured." (tested in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py with a fake `gh`).
  Expected change site: `_execute` in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py (env setup at line 182 and the `env.update` block), or `test_per_tick_cap_is_honoured` (lines 318-326).
  Evidence of absence: `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER` is not pinned, so the test depends on the run number in CI (run 41267984128). The cap itself is honoured (`examined=2`). Same one-line fix as the BLOCKER.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): (1) tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_verify.py `_execute` env filter (line 182): set `"GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER": "0"` in `env.update`, about 1 line; (2) scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh `_verify_one`, where `created_enc` is built: send `created=<merged_at>..<merged_at+1day>`, about 3 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3

  WHY: CI run 41267984128 with `GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER=3` gives START=1 and examines issues 11 and 12. The diff added the rotation without a deterministic test anchor.

  PROBLEM: A single `per_page=100` newest-first read with no pagination logs `runs_truncated` every tick once there are more than 100 runs since `mergedAt`.
  WHY: The heal never gets a held or recurred verdict before it ages out of the 7-day window. `agents.d/heal-verify.md` does not document this limit.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh:~593 (`if ! _post_comment "${number}" "${comment_file}" && ! _post_comment "${number}" "${comment_file}"` block) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3

  WHY: The listing query (`issues(first:50,states:CLOSED,…)`) returns only closed issues, so the heal is never examined again and no `outcome=recurred` marker lands.
